**Limitations**

- An 8-bit image has little dynamic range, so the effect is smaller than on true HDR data.
- Results differ in brightness, since each operator stretches its own way.

**Artifacts**

- Halos around strong edges with Mantiuk at low contrast scale.
- Washed out colors with Drago at high bias.
